canDoYue: 你識要帳單、分開計、用八達通，同埋指出單上面嘅錯。
canDoEn: Ask for the bill, split it, pay with an Octopus card, and point out a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: Could we have the bill now, because we are ready to leave this table?
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋準備離開呢張檯，可唔可以攞帳單？
dialogue.say: Could we have the bill now, because we are ready to leave this table?

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: Here is the full bill, and the service charge sits on the printed total.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張係完整帳單，服務費已經計咗喺總數。
dialogue.say: Here is the full bill, and the service charge sits on the printed total.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: Could we split the bill, because each of us would like a separate receipt?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以分開計，因為我哋每人想要一張收據？
dialogue.say: Could we split the bill, because each of us would like a separate receipt?

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: We can split it by card, or an Octopus card is much easier here.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以用卡分開畀，或者喺呢度用八達通方便啲。
dialogue.say: We can split it by card, or an Octopus card is much easier here.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: An Octopus card is easier, because I do not have a bank card.
dialogue.glossYue: 八達通方便啲，因為我冇帶銀行卡。
dialogue.say: An Octopus card is easier, because I do not have a bank card.

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: I can take that Octopus card when you are ready, then print a receipt.
dialogue.glossYue: 你準備好我就收八達通，然後印張收據。
dialogue.say: I can take that Octopus card when you are ready, then print a receipt.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: There is a clear mistake on the bill, because that soup was never ordered.
dialogue.glossYue: 張單有個清楚嘅錯，因為嗰碗湯我哋冇叫過。
dialogue.say: There is a clear mistake on the bill, because that soup was never ordered.

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: I will correct that mistake and bring a fresh bill before you pay.
dialogue.glossYue: 你畀錢之前，我會改好個錯，再攞張新單嚟。
dialogue.say: I will correct that mistake and bring a fresh bill before you pay.
